about: Generated by tcf-vectors.mjs from the site script's TCF code (cmp/src/tcf): the TC model, TC string and in-app keys of each decision, and the re-ask of a stored string. See README.md.

cases.name: accept_all: every banner purpose, every IAB purpose shown, both special features
reject_all: no consent, no legitimate interest, no special feature

custom: every banner purpose but one, purpose 1 not grouped follows « all granted »

preferences: an explicit vendor consent though its purposes are refused

publisher restrictions: purpose 9 on legitimate interest (flexible vendors on consent → require legitimate interest)

only special feature 2 allowed by the publisher

a lower-case publisher country; language zh-Hant → ZH
